newsitem.title: UK: Polar Air says first half 1997 tonnage up sharply.
newsitem.headline: Polar Air says first half 1997 tonnage up sharply.

text.p: - Polar Air Cargo said that freight ton kilometres were 61.4 percent higher at 946,247,000 FTKs compared to 586,247,000 in the first half of 1997. The load factor rose seven percent system-wide over the same period in the previous year to 79.2 percent, the Long Beach-base carrier said in a statement received here.
"We are very encouraged with the midyear results, especially since the first half of the year is the low season for international air cargo," Polar Air CEO, Ned Wallace said in the statement.

"A healthy global economy and the route network we designed to serve all principal commercial centres around the world are at the heart of this double-digit growth. With the 1997 peak season just starting, Polar Air Cargo should have a banner year and be positioned even better than anticipated for the expansion we have planned in 1998," he added. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
